canonical_name: Cayley's theorem for the regular permutation representation of an arbitrary group
literal_source_claim_zh: 每个群都同构于某个置换群
literal_source_claim_en: Every group is isomorphic to some permutation group.
canonical_statement: For every group G, the left-regular permutation action identifies G with its image subgroup in the full permutation group on the underlying set of G.
canonical_claim: For every universe-polymorphic group G, there exists a multiplicative equivalence from G to the range subgroup of the left-regular homomorphism G ->* Equiv.Perm G.

canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: forall (G : Type u) [Group G], Nonempty (G ≃* (MulAction.toPermHom G G).range)
canonical_formal_target.candidate_type: (G H : Type*) -> [Group G] -> [MulAction G H] -> [FaithfulSMul G H] -> G ≃* (MulAction.toPermHom G H).range

domain_and_universes: universe u; G : Type u; [Group G]; target Prop in universe 0; permutation and range subgroup on the same carrier G; no finiteness or decidable-equality hypothesis.
conclusion: Nonempty (G ≃* (MulAction.toPermHom G G).range), using the inferred left multiplication action.
degenerate_case_status: No group is excluded. Trivial, finite, and infinite groups remain in scope; trivial and infinite-carrier permutation-group conclusion surfaces elaborate in Statement.lean.

a nonfaithful arbitrary action or the generally nonfaithful conjugation action
